jobs.description: Join the G2i Talent Pool We’re always meeting great people in tech. Join the G2i Talent Pool and let us get to know you. G2i works with top AI labs and fast-growing companies. Our community of engineers works on real projects, from evals and RL environments to training data for frontier models. Who we’re looking for Software, data, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, design, QA and product. Experienced or just starting out, fresh graduates are welcome. If you work in tech or are building your career in it, we’d love to meet you. How it works Apply in a few minutes with your real details and links. We review your profile and send you a short technical assessment. Once you pass, you join our pool and hear from us when a project fits your skills. Joining the pool doesn’t mean immediate work, since matching depends on what our clients need and on each profile. But we’re always working to match everyone in our pool with the right project. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the ability to independently define and execute a quality strategy, collaborate closely with developers and product stakeholders, and integrate quality practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). We are evolving beyond traditional, manual-heavy QA approaches toward AI-assisted, automation-first quality engineering. The ideal candidate is technically curious, adaptable, and excited about leveraging modern tools to improve software quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce repetitive work. Drive test strategy: Define risk-based testing approaches and appropriate coverage across API, integration, functional, end-to-end, and non-functional testing. Champion test automation: Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks and AI-assisted development tools. jobs.description: Overview: FinteqHub is expanding the team and is looking for an experienced QA Tech Lead to help strengthen test coverage and develop its testing approach. About Product: Finteqhub А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform. Learn more Purpose of the role: FinteqHub is looking for a QA Tech Lead to shape how our engineering teams approach testing and to help them make good testing decisions on their own. You'll be based in the Payment Integrations team. There you'll drive the migration of our API tests from Java to Go and Gonkey, and from there you'll develop QA practice across all teams. Our stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. Tests are written in Go, Gonkey (YAML), TypeScript and Playwright, with reporting in ReportPortal and mobile testing on BrowserStack. Key responsibilities: Audit the legacy Java API test suite and decide what to keep, what to retire, and what should move to a lower test level. Oversee the AI-assisted migration of tests to Go and Gonkey, and make sure no critical checks are lost. Close coverage gaps in line with the test pyramid, starting with scenarios where money is at risk. Help every team define and document its own test strategy and pyramid, and review them.
